sources.locator: "First Treaty of San Ildefonso", revision 1372949821, § Background

explanation: The 1777 treaty fixed the Río de la Plata borders, and its own background section makes Tordesillas the ambiguity it was fixing. The article reads: "For nearly 300 years, differing interpretations of the Treaty of Tordesillas led to disputes between Spain and Portugal over the Río de la Plata region."
